# XLaya (iscvlab/xlaya)

> 5-Profile Hardware-Adaptive System 1 → System 1.5 Semantic Decision, Regime-Invariant AST Code-Graph Sieve, 2-Stage Tool-Schema Gate, Joint NLI Contradiction Triad & Conformal Triage Sidecar (`v2.3.0`), powered by `laya 0.4.31+` (`ModernBERT-large` `en`, `subfolder="typed-decisions"`, calibrated `0.45*en + 0.55*typed` ensemble & `mmBERT`), `vega-U` (`vegaml 0.16.1+`, `auto`/`0.8b`/`4b`/`gemma-1b`/`27b`/`none`), and a zero-torch / zero-numpy 8-feature AST + call-graph + Corpus-IDF simplex sieve (`policies/sieve_genomes.json`, `5,679 B` LF / `6,020 B` CRLF, `ΔRSS = 10.41 MB`, `3.99 ms` warm / `255.33 ms/repo` cold). Delivered as a warm resident Model Context Protocol server (`xlaya_mcp_server.py`, `6` tools, `~30 ms` warm inference, `859.1 q/s` batched), a standalone CLI (`laya_triage.py`), and a universal AI agent skill (`skills/xlaya/SKILL.md`).

## One-Prompt Universal Agent Install

```text
Clone https://github.com/iscvlab/xlaya and install skills/xlaya into my active agent skills directory (Windows: ./scripts/install.ps1 -All; macOS/Linux: ./scripts/install.sh --all; or copy skills/xlaya into ~/.gemini/config/skills/xlaya, ~/.claude/skills/xlaya, ~/.codex/skills/xlaya, or ~/.agents/skills/xlaya), then run python benchmarks/run_xlaya_benchmark.py --mode quick to verify /xlaya is ready.
```

## Core Entrypoints & Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Architecture, `v2.3.0` 5-tier hardware profiles (`nano`/`edge`/`workstation`/`max`) + dual SWE agent tiers (`e4b-sniper`/`31b-deep`), RTX 5060 Ti benchmarks, one-prompt agent installer, 6 MCP tools, and CLI usage.
- [laya_triage.py](laya_triage.py): Standalone 3-stage CLI & programmatic engine (`--profile auto|nano|edge|workstation|max`, `--agent-tier auto|e4b-sniper|31b-deep`, `--sieve-weights`, `--mode shortlist|contradiction|rubric|classify`, `--lang auto|en|multi|typed|ensemble`, `--thorough`, `--rubric-preset`, `--views 1|2|3`, `--fit-rows`, `--policy-path`, `--image|--audio|--video`, `--vega`, `--vega-model auto|0.8b|4b|gemma-1b|27b|none`, `--whole-file`, `--self-test`).
- [xlaya_mcp_server.py](xlaya_mcp_server.py): Zero-extra-dependency JSON-RPC 2.0 `stdio` MCP server (`xlaya_status`, `xlaya_triage`, `xlaya_predict`, `xlaya_fit`, `xlaya_preload`, `xlaya_unload`) with idle VRAM auto-unload (`LAYA_IDLE_TTL_SEC`).
- [policies/sieve_genomes.json](policies/sieve_genomes.json): Zero-Cheat repo-disjoint CUDA-evolved (`5,000` generations × `256` genomes) 8-feature sign-constrained L1 simplex weights, Platt `(T, b)`, split-conformal `q_hat`, and 2-Stage `tool_gate` (`5,679 B` LF / `6,020 B` CRLF) for `e4b_sniper_distilled` (`K=3`, `≤ 800` tok) and `31b_deep` (`K=8`, `≤ 4,096` tok).
- [docs/figures/](docs/figures/): Academic White-Theme cover (`xlaya_v23_cover_1120x560.png`) and Figures 1–4 (`fig1_system_architecture_flowchart.png`, `fig2_zero_cheat_evolution_workflow.png`, `fig3_blind_evaluation_scorecard.png`, `fig4_pareto_and_codegraph_topology.png`).
- [skills/xlaya/SKILL.md](skills/xlaya/SKILL.md): Portable AI agent skill specification (`/xlaya`, `/laya`) and chained `/x*` combinations (`/xsync /xlaya`, `/xbrief /xlaya`, `/xdeep-research /xlaya`, `/xpublish /xlaya`, `/xlaya /xultra`, `/xlearn /xlaya`, `/xocr /xlaya`).
- [scripts/install.ps1](scripts/install.ps1): Windows PowerShell installer (`./scripts/install.ps1 -All` or `-Target <dir>`).
- [scripts/install.sh](scripts/install.sh): macOS and Linux installer (`./scripts/install.sh --all` or `--target <dir>`).
- [benchmarks/run_xlaya_evolution.py](benchmarks/run_xlaya_evolution.py): Zero-Cheat repo-disjoint 3-Phase CUDA genome evolution & multi-suite verifier (pass `--verify-zero-leakage --manifest <path/to/local_manifest.json>`) across `125` disjoint `@base_commit` SWE + `When2Call train` tasks, `routing_labels.csv` (`85.0%` regression gate / `90.0%` standalone `xlaya_fit` Axis 3), `xerj#1108`, and `PLE 29`.
- [benchmarks/colab_kaggle_l4x4_runner.py](benchmarks/colab_kaggle_l4x4_runner.py): Colab/Kaggle `L4 × 4` hardware verifier & declarative ADK `submission_{31b_deep,e4b_sniper}.zip` builder (`--self-test --build-submissions`).
- [benchmarks/XLAYA_V2_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md](benchmarks/XLAYA_V2_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md): Comprehensive empirical benchmark report on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti (`16 GB VRAM`).
- [benchmarks/xlaya_v23_evolution_results.json](benchmarks/xlaya_v23_evolution_results.json): Verified raw JSON receipts for 100% repo-disjoint v2.3 evolution (`1.28M` evaluations in `74.87 s`), `80.00%`/`85.71%` disjoint val task hit rate, `100.0%` `xerj#1108` accuracy (`0.00%` false-confident), and `10.41 MB` `nano` RSS.
- [benchmarks/run_xlaya_benchmark.py](benchmarks/run_xlaya_benchmark.py): Reproducible Stage 0 + Stage 1 + Stage 2 verification harness (`--mode quick|full`).
- [tests/test_v23_sieve_and_adk.py](tests/test_v23_sieve_and_adk.py): Deterministic pytest suite verifying `G-01` through `G-08`.
